title: ArchMaker Runner Envelope (v1 protocol)
description: Typed envelope of the runner protocol v1 over a Unix socket with session authentication (DEC-004, ADR-0004). The runner only accepts typed operations and never arbitrary scripts. Contract state: draft.

protocolVersion.description: Runner protocol version (axis protocolVersion), negotiated before accepting a manifest.

schemaVersion.description: JSON Schema contract version of the envelope (axis schemaVersion).

sessionId.description: Runner session identifier (UUID); absent only before the session is created.

name.description: Message name. Known commands: runner.hello, session.create, manifest.submit, preflight.start, inventory.read, plan.build, plan.validate, dryRun.start, confirmation.submit, execution.start, execution.cancel, journal.export, session.close. Events follow runner.preflight.*, plan.*, execution.* and journal.*.

payload.description: Message-specific payload. Documented open map: its shape is fixed per message name by the runner protocol; it carries typed operations only and never scripts or shell.

sentAt.description: Ephemeral send timestamp; excluded from the canonical hash payload.
